title: A First Bank Account
story:
Noor turned sixteen and opened her first bank account. She went to the local bank with her father and a folder of papers. The clerk asked for her name, her address, and a document that showed who she was. Noor showed her student card and a letter from school. The clerk said an account was a safe place to keep money.

Noor chose a savings account because she did not need a shop card yet. She made a deposit of thirty euros from birthday gifts. The clerk printed a small book that showed her balance. The balance was thirty euros. A line in the book said the bank would not take a monthly fee while she was a student. Noor started to write her secret number, then remembered that she should keep it only in her head. She tore up the paper and picked a number she could remember.

Each Friday she added five euros from babysitting. She checked the balance on a screen inside the bank because she wanted to see the figures herself. One Friday she nearly took ten euros out for a concert. She stopped, thought about her plan, and left the money where it was. Three months later the balance was ninety euros. Noor felt proud that the money was still there. Her father smiled and said the habit mattered more than one concert. She wrote the new balance in a notebook at home.

quiz.question: What did Noor open on her sixteenth birthday?
quiz.explanation: She opened her first bank account when she turned sixteen.
quiz.supportingSentence: Noor turned sixteen and opened her first bank account.

quiz.question: How much money did she put in from birthday gifts?
quiz.explanation: Her first deposit was thirty euros from birthday gifts.
quiz.supportingSentence: She made a deposit of thirty euros from birthday gifts.

quiz.question: Why did the bank skip the monthly fee?
options: Her father worked at the bank
The balance was already ninety euros
She never chose a secret number
quiz.explanation: The book said there was no monthly fee while she was a student.
quiz.supportingSentence: A line in the book said the bank would not take a monthly fee while she was a student.

quiz.question: In this story, what is a deposit?
options: Money placed into a bank account
A secret number for a card
quiz.correctAnswer: Money placed into a bank account
quiz.explanation: Noor put thirty euros into the account, and that money was a deposit.
quiz.supportingSentence: She made a deposit of thirty euros from birthday gifts.

quiz.question: Why did Noor leave the ten euros in the bank?
options: Her plan mattered more than the concert
The concert was cancelled that Friday
Her father took the cash out
The screen at the bank was broken
quiz.correctAnswer: Her plan mattered more than the concert
quiz.explanation: She thought about her plan and chose not to take the money out.
quiz.supportingSentence: She stopped, thought about her plan, and left the money where it was.
